title: REQ · The store's execution ID validation is reusable by other packages
summary: store exports ValidateID so reports use the identical rule
description: Context: store.validateID is unexported, so another package cannot apply the same rule. Desired behavior: an exported store.ValidateID with identical behavior, used by Save and Get. Expected result: one source of truth for ID safety. Why: the intent requires validating the ID the same way the state store does.
acceptance_criteria: Given "../evil" or an empty string, When store.ValidateID is called, Then it returns an error wrapping ErrInvalidID
Given "exec-1.2", When store.ValidateID is called, Then it returns nil

in_scope: Rename validateID to ValidateID in store.go
preserve: Save and Get rejecting bad ids

definition_of_done: ValidateID exported and used by Save and Get
